title: A homomorphism problem for flows
exact_target: Does a homomorphism between two abelian Cayley graphs guarantee that every flow using the first allowed value set can be replaced by one using the second?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, supplied problems.json, record 3220 (OPG-134), OpenGarden. Catalogue identity and source transcription; CC BY 4.0.
Open Problem Garden, A homomorphism problem for flows. Original problem and discussion.

status_qualification: Makes the standard zero-free connection-set convention explicit; allowing zero while declaring Cayley graphs simple creates a degenerate false variant.
